title: A counterexample to the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We disprove the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture by constructing graphs whose chromatic number exceeds their Colin de Verdière invariant by more than one. The examples have independence number at most two. In fact, their ordinary fractional chromatic number also exceeds their Colin de Verdière invariant by more than one.
